evaluation.results_summary: The developer states that the model was created to test the GRPO training approach introduced in DeepSeek R1.

possible_risks.description: A membership inference attack repeatedly queries a model to determine if a given input was part of the model's training. More specifically, given a trained model and a data sample, an attacker appropriately samples the input space, observing outputs to deduce whether that sample was part of the model's training.
possible_risks.justification: Trained on openai/gsm8k and open-weight, so an attacker can run the checkpoint locally and perform membership inference on that known public training dataset.

specifications.model_size: 6.0 GiB of safetensors weights (6,425,528,792 bytes) in F16

training_context.training_data: The model was trained on the openai/gsm8k dataset.
